articles.editor.title.description: Heading and document title of the article editor, where the user writes a long post in Markdown with a title, a summary and a cover image.

articles.editor.title.edit.description: Heading and document title of the article editor when it edits an article the user published.

articles.editor.write.description: Link under the new-post form to the article editor, for a long post with a title in Markdown.

articles.not_allowed.title.defaultMessage: このサーバーでは記事を書けません
articles.not_allowed.title.description: Heading of the article editor when the server lets only some roles write new articles and the user has none of them.

articles.not_allowed.body.defaultMessage: このサーバーでは、新しい記事を書けるのは一部のロールだけです。公開した記事は今までどおり編集できます。
articles.not_allowed.body.description: Under the heading of the article editor when the user may not write new articles.

articles.field.title.description: Label of the field of the article's title in the article editor.

articles.field.summary.description: Label of the field of the article's summary in the article editor.

articles.field.summary.description.defaultMessage: 記事が一覧に出るとき、題の下に表示されます。空のままにすると、本文の初めから作られます。
articles.field.summary.description.description: Help under the summary field of the article editor.

articles.field.cover.description: Label of the group of the article's cover image in the article editor: its picker, description and removal.

articles.cover.choose.description: Button of the article editor that opens the file picker for the article's cover image.

articles.cover.replace.defaultMessage: カバー画像を差し替える
articles.cover.replace.description: Button of the article editor that opens the file picker for another cover image in place of the one chosen.

articles.cover.remove.description: Button of the article editor that takes the cover image off the article.

articles.cover.description.description: Label of the field of the cover image's alternative text in the article editor.

articles.cover.uploading.defaultMessage: カバー画像をアップロードしています…
articles.cover.uploading.description: Shown in the article editor while the chosen cover image uploads.

articles.cover.processing.defaultMessage: サーバーがカバー画像を処理しています。
articles.cover.processing.description: Shown in the article editor after the cover image uploaded and before the server has made its renditions.

articles.cover.failed.defaultMessage: サーバーがこのカバー画像を処理できませんでした。別の画像を選んでください。
articles.cover.failed.description: Shown in the article editor when the server failed to process the uploaded cover image.

articles.field.body.description: Label of the text area of the article's body in Markdown, in the article editor.

articles.field.body.description.defaultMessage: Markdown で書きます。# で見出し、**文字** で太字になります。画像はドロップ・貼り付け・追加で入り、説明は角かっこの中に書きます。
articles.field.body.description.description: Help under the body of the article editor. An image goes into the body as ![description](media:ID), and its description is the text between the square brackets.

articles.format.bold.description: Button above the body of the article editor that makes the selected text bold (Ctrl+B).

articles.format.link.description: Button above the body of the article editor that makes the selected text a link and selects its address to type (Ctrl+K).

articles.format.image.description: Button above the body of the article editor that opens the file picker for images to put into the body at the caret.

articles.images.drop.defaultMessage: ドロップして本文に追加
articles.images.drop.description: Shown over the body of the article editor while image files are dragged over it.

articles.images.uploading.defaultMessage: {count, plural, other {# 枚の画像をアップロードしています…}}
articles.images.uploading.description: Under the body of the article editor while dropped, pasted or picked images upload; they go into the body once uploaded.

articles.images.failed.defaultMessage: 画像をアップロードできませんでした: {reason}
articles.images.failed.description: Under the body or the cover image of the article editor when an image failed to upload. {reason} is the server's or the network's explanation.

articles.images.unsupported.defaultMessage: 記事に入れられる画像は JPEG・PNG・GIF・WebP だけです。
articles.images.unsupported.description: Shown in the article editor when a dropped, pasted or picked file is not an image the server takes.

articles.field.tags.description: Label of the field of the article's hashtags in the article editor.

articles.field.tags.description.defaultMessage: スペースで区切って {max, number} 個まで。記事はこのハッシュタグで一覧に載ります。本文の # は文字のままです。
articles.field.tags.description.description: Help under the hashtags field of the article editor. {max} is the most hashtags an article takes.

articles.field.language.description: Label of the select of the article's language in the article editor.

articles.field.visibility.description: Label of the select of who can see the article, in the article editor. An article cannot be a direct message.

articles.field.sensitive.defaultMessage: センシティブな内容にする
articles.field.sensitive.description: Checkbox of the article editor: readers see the title and the summary, and the cover and the body are folded until they show them.

articles.field.sensitive.description.defaultMessage: 読む人にはまず題と要約が表示され、カバー画像と本文は開くまで畳まれます。
articles.field.sensitive.description.description: Help under the sensitive checkbox of the article editor.

articles.preview.heading.description: Heading of the region of the article editor that shows the article as readers will see it, rendered by the server.

articles.preview.empty.defaultMessage: 本文を書くと、読む人に見える形でここに表示されます。
articles.preview.empty.description: The preview of the article editor while the body is empty.

articles.preview.failed.defaultMessage: プレビューを表示できませんでした: {reason}
articles.preview.failed.description: The preview of the article editor when the server could not render the body. {reason} is the server's or the network's explanation.

articles.preview.summary_from_body.defaultMessage: 要約が空なので、本文の初めから作りました
articles.preview.summary_from_body.description: Under the summary in the preview of the article editor when the user wrote none and the server made it from the body.

articles.preview.sensitive.defaultMessage: センシティブな内容です。カバー画像と本文は、読む人が開いて表示します。
articles.preview.sensitive.description: In the preview of the article editor when the article is marked as sensitive.

articles.preview.size.defaultMessage: {bytes, number} / {maxBytes, number} バイト、画像 {images, number} / {maxImages, number} 枚
articles.preview.size.description: Under the preview of the article editor: the size of the rendered body and the number of its images, against the server's limits. {bytes} and {maxBytes} are numbers of bytes.

articles.preview.over.defaultMessage: 本文がサーバーの上限を超えています。公開する前に、短くするか画像を減らしてください。
articles.preview.over.description: Under the preview of the article editor when the rendered body is larger than the server takes, or has more images.

articles.autosave.saving.defaultMessage: 下書きを保存しています…
articles.autosave.saving.description: In the article editor while it saves the article as a draft on the server, a moment after the user stops typing.

articles.autosave.saved.defaultMessage: 下書きを保存しました
articles.autosave.saved.description: In the article editor once the article is saved as a draft on the server, which opens on any device from the drafts page.

articles.autosave.failed.defaultMessage: 下書きを保存できていません
articles.autosave.failed.description: In the article editor when the draft could not be saved; the reason follows.

articles.autosave.failed.detail.defaultMessage: 下書きを保存できませんでした: {reason}。次に書き換えたときにもう一度保存します。
articles.autosave.failed.detail.description: In the article editor when the draft could not be saved. {reason} is the server's or the network's explanation.

articles.autosave.conflict.defaultMessage: 開いた後にこの下書きがほかの端末で変更されたため、上書きしませんでした。書いた文章はここに残っていますが、書くたびの保存は止まっています。
articles.autosave.conflict.description: In the article editor when the draft was saved on another device meanwhile: nothing was overwritten, the text stays in the editor, and saving stops until the user saves it as a new draft.

articles.autosave.save_new.defaultMessage: 新しい下書きとして保存
articles.autosave.save_new.description: Button after the conflict message of the article editor: saves the text as another draft, leaving the other device's draft as it is, and saving goes on as the user types.

articles.publish.description: Submit button of the article editor: publishes the article now.

articles.save_edit.description: Submit button of the article editor when it edits a published article.

articles.schedule.description: Button of the article editor that opens the popover to choose when the article is published.

articles.schedule.scheduled.description: The schedule button of the article editor when the draft is scheduled already. {date} is the date and time.

articles.published.description: Toast after the article editor published the article; the article's page opens.

articles.updated.description: Toast after the article editor saved the changes of a published article; the article's page opens.

articles.publish.failed.defaultMessage: 記事を公開できませんでした: {reason}
articles.publish.failed.description: Beside the publish button of the article editor when publishing failed. {reason} is the server's or the network's explanation.

articles.update.failed.defaultMessage: 変更を保存できませんでした: {reason}
articles.update.failed.description: Beside the save button of the article editor when saving the changes of a published article failed. {reason} is the server's or the network's explanation.

articles.blocked.title.defaultMessage: 記事に題を付けてください。
articles.blocked.title.description: Under the title field and beside the publish button of the article editor, after publish or schedule was pressed without a title.

articles.blocked.text.defaultMessage: 記事の本文を書いてください。
articles.blocked.text.description: Under the body and beside the publish button of the article editor, after publish or schedule was pressed with an empty body.

articles.blocked.tags.defaultMessage: 記事に付けられるハッシュタグは {max, number} 個までです。
articles.blocked.tags.description: Under the hashtags field and beside the publish button of the article editor, after publish was pressed with too many hashtags.

articles.blocked.uploading.defaultMessage: 画像のアップロードが終わるまで待ってください。
articles.blocked.uploading.description: Beside the publish button of the article editor, after it was pressed while an image or the cover was still uploading.
